_comment: Companion to example.json. Same schema EXCEPT `topics` is an array of plain strings rather than {id,label,blurb,keywords} objects. Both shapes are legal and both are in use; the route normalizes the string form. This file exists so that the normalizer's regression test can run on a clone with no private config - see tests/radar-topics-shape.test.js.
title: Example - String Topics
subtitle: The older topics shape, kept as a fixture for the normalizer.
